newsitem.title: USA: Genesis aims for $1.12 bln revs in FY 97.
newsitem.headline: Genesis aims for $1.12 bln revs in FY 97.

text.p: Genesis Health Ventures Inc is aiming for pro forma revenues of $1.12 billion in fiscal 1997 and $1.31 billion the following year, Chief Financial Officer George Hager said on Wednesday.

The nursing home and sub-acute care company posted pro forma revenues of $671.5 million in fiscal 1996 ended September 30. Net income for the year was $1.29 per share, including a one-time charge of $0.02 per share.
The revenue targets exclude the potential impact of future acquisitions, for which Genesis is always on the lookout, Hager said at a Raymond James investors conference in St. Petersburg Beach.
A dominant sub-acute care provider in the Philadelphia and Baltimore markets, Genesis has made a series of key acquisitions in recent years and expanded into New England and Florida.

Hager said the company was in the midst of shifting away from the nursing home business, which has relatively low margins and is dominated by Medicaid payments, and toward higher-margin specialty medical businesses.
